scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w frontend
